notes: Tax obligation per GL account: posting accounts / active cost centres, ACC_SERIAL = max + 1 over the table, range button (تطبيق) - APP_RULES3_TX, see processes/TX_ACCOUNTS.md

actions.name: APPLY
actions.confirm_a: هل تريد تطبيق النسبة على الحسابات المحددة؟
actions.confirm_e: Apply the percentage to the account range?

params.name: TAX
params.lov_sql: select tax_code || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(name_e, name_a) else name_a end d, tax_code r from tx_taxes_types order by tax_code

params.name: FROM_ACC
params.lov_sql: select account_number || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(account_name_e, account_name) else account_name end d, account_number r from ac_master where account_status = 1 order by account_number

params.name: TO_ACC
params.lov_sql: select account_number || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(account_name_e, account_name) else account_name end d, account_number r from ac_master where account_status = 1 order by account_number

params.name: COST1
params.lov_sql: select cost_code || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(cost_desc_e, cost_desc) else cost_desc end d, cost_code r from ac_cost_centers where cost_status = 1 order by cost_code

params.name: COST2
params.lov_sql: select cost_code || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(cost_desc_e, cost_desc) else cost_desc end d, cost_code r from ac_cost_centers2 where cost_status = 1 order by cost_code
